name: Break Panic! Natsuyasumi dayo! Oyakodon
original_name: BREAK PANIC！夏休みだよ！親子丼
source:
Hiromu returned home from college for a while in order to work part time at the holiday villa.
There he spend time with Misaki, who appears tough on the surface but is interested in sex, and her mother Misao, who is sexually frustrated and seduces him.
